description_en: Queries users in a specified workspace with paging. Use nameLike to filter by username with fuzzy match, maxResults to specify the maximum number of records per page, and nextToken to retrieve the next page. If maxResults is not specified, the server returns 10 records by default
description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间内的用户。通过 nameLike 按用户名称模糊过滤，通过 maxResults 指定单页最大记录数，通过 nextToken 获取下一页。未指定 maxResults 时服务端默认返回 10 条
name: ListUsers

parameters.help_en: The filter condition for exact match by username
parameters.help_zh: 按用户名称精确匹配的过滤条件
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The filter condition for fuzzy match by username. The value can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 按用户名称模糊匹配的过滤条件，长度不超过 128 个字符
parameters.name: name_like

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 单页返回的最大记录数，取值范围为 1~100。不指定该参数时默认返回 10 条
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next page. Do not specify this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, set this parameter to the nextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 查询下一页的游标。首次调用不指定该参数，后续调用指定上一次返回的 nextToken
parameters.name: next_token

authMethod.description_en: The authentication method of the user. A value of password indicates local password authentication in the workspace. Values of dingtalk and feishu indicate that the user is synchronized and authenticated by the corresponding external identity provider
authMethod.description_zh: 用户的认证方式。password 表示使用工作空间本地密码认证，dingtalk 和 feishu 表示由对应的外部身份提供商同步并认证

createdAt.description_en: The creation time in UTC, formatted in RFC 3339
createdAt.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

displayName.description_en: The display name of the user. The value is 1 to 32 characters in length
displayName.description_zh: 用户显示名称，长度为 1~32 个字符

email.description_en: The email address of the user. The value can be up to 256 characters in length
email.description_zh: 用户邮箱地址，长度不超过 256 个字符

name.description_en: The username. The value must be unique within the workspace and can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It must start and end with a lowercase letter or digit. The value is 1 to 32 characters in length
name.description_zh: 用户名称。在工作空间内唯一，只能包含小写字母、数字和连字符，必须以小写字母或数字开头和结尾，长度为 1~32 个字符

note.description_en: The remarks of the user. The value can be up to 1024 characters in length
note.description_zh: 用户备注，长度不超过 1024 个字符

regionId.description_en: The region ID of the resource

status.description_en: The user status. Valid values: Creating, Active, Updating, Deleting, Failed, DeleteFailed

updatedAt.description_en: The time of the last modification in UTC, formatted in RFC 3339
updatedAt.description_zh: 最近一次修改的时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式的 UTC 时间

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records per page that takes effect for this query
maxResults.description_zh: 本次查询生效的单页最大记录数

message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned if the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求失败时返回错误描述

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. This value is empty if no more pages are available
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页游标。没有下一页时为空

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

totalCount.description_en: The total number of users that match the query conditions
totalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的用户总数
